architecture.phase_sensor: independent shared 30/60/120/240-minute directional impulse state for Asia 18:00-02:00 ET, Europe 02:00-09:30 ET, and US 09:30-17:00 ET
architecture.acceptance: phase turn aligned with resolved macro plus same-sign matched-MCL five-minute movement
architecture.challenge: opposed CL phase turn flattens any phase position and arms one challenge without entry
architecture.failure_reversal: before phase end, with macro unchanged, completed CL five-minute close reclaims the frozen challenge anchor and matched MCL moves in macro direction
architecture.position_boundary: flat on phase, macro-state, contract, and evaluation-period changes

categorical_cells.signal_close: reclaim the opposing signal bar close
categorical_cells.signal_body: reclaim the opposing signal bar open
categorical_cells.signal_range: reclaim the opposing signal bar far extreme

advancement: Only cells passing every count gate in both independent periods may enter a separately preregistered discovery-first economic lifecycle. Count cannot select by PnL.
prohibitions: no trade outcomes in this census
no continuous threshold or timing sweep
